item.title: The Impossible Reality Inside a Black Hole
item.author: Astrum
item.content:encoded:
What lies beyond the Event Horizon? Try Brilliant’s interactive tutor for free and get 20% off an annual Premium subscription at http://brilliant.org/astrum
▀▀▀▀▀▀
In all of space, nothing is more mind-meltingly strange than a black hole. These cosmic monsters are places where space becomes time, time becomes space, and the fundamental laws of physics simply cease to exist. But what if the event horizon isn't the final boundary?
Way past the point of no return, deep inside spinning Kerr black holes, lies a theoretical boundary even stranger than the first: the Cauchy Horizon. Beyond this threshold, spacetime breaks down entirely, cause and effect collapse, and physics yields to pure, unpredictable madness.
From the lethal trap of spaghettification to time-looping curves and infinite mass inflation, discover what happens when you attempt the ultimate one-way trip into the abyss....
▀▀▀▀▀▀

item.title: What Is Hiding In The Milky Way's Core?
item.author: Astrum
item.content:encoded:
This one image is starting an exoplanet revolution. JMP is an interactive statistical discovery software for scientists and engineers to explore data visually, uncover meaningful patterns, and make confident data-driven decisions. Check out http://jmp.com/astrum for your free trial.
▀▀▀▀▀▀
On 23rd March 2025 the Euclid telescope captured the most detailed visible-light image ever taken of the cosmic bulge of our Milky Way galaxy. It’s packed with 60 million stars, but that’s not all. And where there are stars, there are planets - millions of them. Could this image be the key to finding them?

item.title: The Reason Britain Failed at Suez
item.author: Imperial War Museums
item.content:encoded:
In 1956, Britain, France and Israel launched a secret plan to invade Egypt and seize back control of the Suez Canal. But the Suez Crisis would end in humiliation and expose the limits of British power.
Discover why the Suez Crisis happened, how Gamal Abdel Nasser and Anthony Eden became locked in confrontation, and why the invasion changed Britain’s place in the world.

item.title: Have We Finally Found a New Theory of Everything?
item.author: Astrum
item.content:encoded:
Could this new theory of how space and time work explain everything in the universe? Thanks to Displate for sponsoring this video. ▀▀▀▀▀▀
The laws of physics that govern our universe have left scientists with a lot of questions. But what if there was a simpler way to look at the universe? A method that takes into account the speed of light, time dilation, redshift, dark energy and an expanding universe? My brother, Jon, has come up with just such a hypothesis for a unified theory of everything that could explain all these and more. The biggest question is - could he be right?

Triton is no ordinary moon. With an impossibly young surface and active cryovolcanoes, Neptune’s giant moon has baffled scientists for decades. How can this frozen world be so active, so far from the Sun? In this video, we’re digging into the latest discoveries, including a surprising mystery hiding deep beneath its icy crust.

item.title: What Is It Like on the Surface of a Black Hole Planet?
item.author: Astrum
item.content:encoded:
Scientists are searching for missing planets in the most unlikely place. Astrum books are still available in the US! If you’re fascinated by the cosmos, want to learn more about our Solar System, or just love stunning space images, get your hands on an Astrum book here: https://astrumspace.co/
▀▀▀▀▀▀
At the edge of a supermassive black hole lies one of the most violent, hostile environments in the cosmos. It's the last place anyone expected to find a planet, but scientists now believe missing worlds could be lurking here. How do these black hole planets form? What are their surfaces like? And how do we actually find them?
